description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Authorization Perl module, which manages validation of action requests based on pre-defined roles and capabilities. It includes rules for permissions related to user actions, organization management, project handling, and recipe operations, along with methods to check capabilities and roles.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Authorization
classes.description: Main class for authorization logic, managing rules and capabilities.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Singleton constructor for the Authorization class.

methods.name: capability_exists
methods.description: Checks if a capability is defined.

methods.name: capability_needs_input
methods.description: Returns the list of input keys needed for a capability.

methods.name: has_capability
methods.description: Determines if a user has a specific capability given input parameters.

methods.name: organization_roles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles within an organization.

methods.name: project_roles
methods.description: Returns the list of roles within a project.
